ideas.idea: Check truncation bias in strict-local-martingale pricing
ideas.assumptions: The process, truncation conditions and CEV parameters must fit the stated theorem.

ideas.evidence: For one-dimensional strict local martingales of the form $\mathrm{d} X_t=σ(X_t) \mathrm{d} W_t$ starting from $X_{0}=x_{0}>0$, we prove the strong rate $\mathbb{E}\left[|X^h_N-X_T|\right] \lesssim h^{\min\{θα,\frac{1}{2}\}}$ for a discrete scheme~$X^h$ truncated at a level $h^{-α}$, with time step~$h$, as $h\downarrow 0$, where~$θ$ depends on the truncation property.
ideas.title: Strong rate for one-dimensional driftless continuous strict local martingales
